subject: CedarBridge procurement paths & marketplace interest — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Holt <james.holt@cedarbridge.com>, Sarah Locke <sarah.locke@cedarbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: CedarBridge procurement paths & marketplace interest — post-call recap and next steps

Hi James / Sarah —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get procurement moving in the right lane: 

Recap (from our conversation)
- CedarBridge is evaluating three primary procurement paths for Redwood:
  1) AWS Marketplace (Private Offer) — preferred for central IT if listing can match committed pricing and term.
  2) PO (net-30/45) with standard invoicing via finance.
  3) Card for pilot/subscription purchases (short-term).
- Procurement signals: legal will require our standard security addenda and SOC2 evidence; finance will want a PO/PO process for any multi-quarter commit.
- Timeline: CedarBridge expects to decide on preferred route by mid-May; procurement/IT windows vary by vendor type.

Immediate asks / next steps
- Can you confirm the procurement contact and whether we should start a private offer with AWS Marketplace or circulate a PO? You listed procurement@cedarbridge.com as a possible intake — is that correct?
- Attached is a short pricing summary I promised on the call (pricing_summary_v1.pdf). Ben from our commercial team is looped for any pricing clarifications.
- If AWS Marketplace is the preferred path, we’ll send a marketplace enablement checklist and the steps we need from CedarBridge (legal contact, billing owner, PO/PO number format).

Proposed next meeting
- Procurement + Legal sync: Tue May 2, 2028 — 14:00 PT (I’ll hold the slot unless you prefer a different time).

If you prefer the PO path, we can prepare a standard PO-ready invoice template and the SOW/terms to circulate. If you prefer Marketplace, we’ll surface the private offer timeline (usually 1–3 weeks to prepare listing, + review cycles).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
mailto:tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0186
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing_summary_v1.pdf (2 pages, stub)

From: James Holt <james.holt@cedarbridge.com>

Cc: Sarah Locke <sarah.locke@cedarbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Apr 2028 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CedarBridge procurement paths & marketplace interest — post-call recap and next steps

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement intake: yes, procurement@cedarbridge.com is correct. I’ll also loop in James Patel (our procurement lead) once you send the checklist.
- Initial preference: our IT and finance teams are leaning towards AWS Marketplace (private offer) because it integrates with our internal procurement tooling and reduces manual invoice handling – but Legal will want to see the contract language before we commit.
- Timelines: Marketplace listing + internal approvals will likely take ~3–5 weeks (longer if Legal has redlines). A PO route could be faster if we don’t require a marketplace onboarding step, but that creates extra AP processing for us.

Action items for Redwood:
- Please share the marketplace enablement checklist and any sample private-offer wording for legal to review.
- If you can provide a PO-ready invoice and your standard security addendum, I’ll route those to our finance and legal teams.

We’re open to the May 2nd slot for a procurement sync — if you can invite our procurement lead (I’ll confirm name & email later today).

James
James Holt | Head of Partnerships, CedarBridge Therapeutics
james.holt@cedarbridge.com | +1 (617) 555-1212
